name: Al Castagno
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Al Castagno in Ehrwald**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps** in **Tirol**, **Ehrwald** is a picturesque village that invites you to experience the magic of the mountains. At **Al Castagno**, you’ll find a cozy retreat where tradition meets modern comfort.

Our family-run hotel offers warm hospitality, delicious **Tiroler cuisine**, and breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. Whether you’re here for skiing, hiking, or simply relaxing, **Al Castagno** is your perfect home base.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast or enjoy a hearty **Gröstl** after a day on the slopes. The rustic charm of our lodge, combined with the fresh mountain air, makes every stay unforgettable.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Al Castagno** is easily accessible, yet feels worlds away from the hustle and bustle. Come and discover why **Ehrwald** is a hidden gem in the **Tiroler Alps**—where adventure and tranquility go hand in hand.

**We look forward to welcoming you!**
